extName.message: HangulBond - Fix Korean filenames on upload

extDescription.message: Stops Korean file names uploaded from Chrome on Mac from breaking into separated letters (ㅎㅏㄴㄱㅡㄹ) on Windows and the web.

uploadHelp.message: Sends Korean file names uploaded from Chrome on Mac in their normal form (NFC).

downloadHelp.message: Saves downloaded files with decomposed Korean names in their normal form. Chrome asks for permission to manage downloads when you turn this on.
